definitions.explanation: Brilliantly showy and glamorous; splendidly decorated with bright colors or lights.

examples.japanese: {煌|きら}びやかな{衣装|いしょう}を{着|き}ている。
{煌|きら}びやかなイルミネーション。
{煌|きら}びやかな{世界|せかい}に{憧|あこが}れる。
examples.english: To long for a glamorous world.

notes:
KANJI NOTE:
{煌} means "sparkling" or "glittering" and appears in words related to brightness and splendor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {煌|きら}びやかな{衣装|いしょう}: gorgeous costume
- {煌|きら}びやかな{装飾|そうしょく}: dazzling decorations
- {煌|きら}びやかな{舞台|ぶたい}: splendid stage
- {煌|きら}びやかな{世界|せかい}: glamorous world

SIMILAR ADJECTIVES:
- {華|はな}やか: gorgeous, brilliant
- きらきら: sparkling, glittering
- ゴージャス: gorgeous (loanword)
